name: Valle de Santibáñez (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a red saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Santibáñez (a chevron with castles on red above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Santibáñez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valle de Santibáñez arms — chevron with castles above waves
